threads.body:
Please add a regression test with an invocation that implements only `_on_stream_chunk` and has no `_request_stream`. The new protocol is intentionally narrower than `GenAIInvocation`, but the current seam fake still defines `_request_stream` (`tests/test_stream.py:448-455`), so these tests would pass even if this conditional were removed or if the wrapper still required the private attribute; the sync path's protocol-only decoupling is otherwise unverified.

This issue also appears on line 237 of the same file.
threads.hunk:
@@ -115,15 +124,13 @@ class SyncStreamWrapper(
     def __init__(
         self,
         stream: _SyncStream[ChunkT],
-        invocation: GenAIInvocation | None = None,
+        invocation: _StreamTimingInvocation | None = None,
     ):
         super().__init__(stream)
         self._self_finalized = False
-        # Marks the request as streamed (gen_ai.request.stream) and receives
-        # per-chunk timing via _on_stream_chunk.
         self._self_invocation = invocation
-        if invocation is not None:
-            invocation._request_stream = True
+        if invocation is not None and hasattr(invocation, "_request_stream"):
+            setattr(invocation, "_request_stream", True)
